versions.investigation: CloudTrail lookup-events (EventName=PublishLayerVersion20181031, us-west-2) returned zero results for a tight window around this timestamp -- but CloudTrail Event History's default retention is ~90 days, and 2026-08-23 minus 90 days is ~2026-05-25, so April 2026 is OUTSIDE the queryable window. This is a ceiling, not evidence of absence -- recorded honestly as such. gh run list found no GitHub Actions run in either repo at the exact timestamp (nearest enceladus activity is ~28-54 minutes away; devops repo shows zero runs in the window, consistent with every other window checked in this task). This version was NOT independently confirmed as manual-CLI the way :11/:12 were; it is enumerated here as a gap, not assumed to share their channel.
